_doc: Driver registry for the products module. 'registered' entries mirror the lab's ACTS/qtyFor at RC8.11 and are verified against the live lab file by tools/validate.mjs (drift => failure). 'proposed' entries do NOT exist in the lab; adding them needs a qtyFor()/estimate() change that this phase was not authorized to make (index.html is excluded).

EQUIP_EA.costAttachment: A07 M = qty*g.equipUnitCost*costF (flat 62000/EA, index.html:2094-2095); EQT meshes are proxy boxes only

PTS_EA.costAttachment: A12 M = qty*matU*costF; EA counts DDC points

DAMPER_FSD_EA.needs: new additive allowance in estimate() like the takeoffEA line, or a new ACTS row; A04's driver is DUCT_LBS

EXH_FAN_EA.needs: new qtyFor key + estimate() allowance; g.equipEA = round(tonnage/75) does not include exhaust fans

leftAlone.TAKEOFF_EA: qtyFor() key not used as any ACTS driver; estimate() reads g.takeoffEA directly inside A04. Not used by this module.
